name: Business
tagline: Build the skills to manage, market, and launch a business.
description: Financial Services pathway is a three-course CTAE program under the Finance Career Cluster designed to teach personal money management, banking operations, and investment strategies.

courses.title: Intro to Business & Technology
courses.desc: Foundational course covering business fundamentals and workplace technology.

courses.title: Banking, Investing, & Insurance
courses.desc: Students explore core concepts across banking operations, investment planning, and personal and business risk management. Through practical projects and case studies, students analyze financial performance, evaluate ethical regulations and fraud prevention, and explore financial careers.

courses.title: Financial Literacy
courses.desc: The course is designed to help students understand personal finance, manage money wisely, set financial goals, and develop realistic, measurable objectives to become "MONEY SMART!"

courses.title: AP Business with Personal Finance
courses.desc: AP Business with Personal Finance is an introductory, college-level business and personal finance course. Students explore the business disciplines of entrepreneurship, marketing, finance, accounting, and management through real-world business application, case studies, and project-based learning. In addition, students learn and apply all the National Standards for Personal Financial Education created by the Council for Economic Education and the Jump$tart Coalition for Personal Financial Literacy.

courses.title: Work-Based Learning
courses.desc: Work-based learning program connects high school academic instruction with structured, real-world industry experience, allowing qualified students to earn CTAE course credit

clubs.name: Future Business Leaders of America (FBLA)
clubs.description:
Future Business Leaders of America (FBLA) is a non-profit career and technical student organization that prepares middle school, high school, and college students for careers in business and leadership.

FBLA focuses on inspiring students to become community-minded business leaders through its core tenets of service, education, and progress. Structured into middle school, high school, collegiate, and professional divisions, the organization serves a vast network of members globally. Participants engage in competitive events at various conference levels and benefit from leadership development, networking, and community service initiatives.
